mediapipe/face_landmarker.task: face detection + 478 3D landmarks + 52 blendshape coefficients + facial transform
mediapipe/face_landmarker.input: RGB image; internal face detector 192x192, mesh 256x256, float16
mediapipe/face_landmarker.notes: Bundle of BlazeFace (short-range), FaceMesh-V2, Blendshape-V2. Blendshapes are ARKit-style motion coefficients, NOT FACS Action Units.

opengraphau/resnet50_s2.task: 41 facial Action Unit occurrence probabilities (27 AUs + 14 unilateral) from a 224x224 aligned face crop
opengraphau/resnet50_s2.input: float32 [1,3,224,224], RGB, ImageNet mean/std; square crop margin 1.3 around face box, resize 256, center crop 224
opengraphau/resnet50_s2.output: float32 [1,41] sigmoid probabilities in OPENGRAPHAU_NAMES order
opengraphau/resnet50_s2.notes: MEFL stage-2 ResNet-50 (Luo et al. IJCAI 2022). Trained on BP4D, DISFA, RAF-AU, Aff-Wild2, CK+, CASME II. Upstream hybrid-set F1 23.24. Converted with experiments/export_opengraphau_onnx.py; original checkpoint sha256 72a02eaa18ef35d6c72c96dca3c099e705731fe846e15395d17dee8ac702e71d.

opengraphau/resnet18_s2.task: 41 facial Action Unit occurrence probabilities (27 AUs + 14 unilateral) from a 224x224 aligned face crop
opengraphau/resnet18_s2.input: float32 [1,3,224,224], RGB, ImageNet mean/std; square crop margin 1.3 around face box, resize 256, center crop 224
opengraphau/resnet18_s2.output: float32 [1,41] sigmoid probabilities in OPENGRAPHAU_NAMES order
opengraphau/resnet18_s2.notes: MEFL stage-2 ResNet-18, ~4x faster than resnet50 (17 ms vs 67 ms CPU on M5 Pro), upstream hybrid-set F1 22.51. Original checkpoint sha256 5debc10e9a1dd57264aa239502e85250bef0b0b399d4aae0e8a5a96cbc300688.

silero/vad_v6.task: voice activity detection: speech probability per 32 ms chunk at 16 kHz
silero/vad_v6.input: float32 [1,576] (64 context + 512 chunk), state float32 [2,1,128], sr int64 16000
silero/vad_v6.notes: Silero VAD v6.2.1 ONNX file pinned by tag. The silero-vad pip package is not used because it depends on torch.

mediapipe/pose_landmarker_lite.task: single-person pose: 33 body landmarks with visibility
mediapipe/pose_landmarker_lite.input: RGB image; internal detector + landmark model (lite), float16
mediapipe/pose_landmarker_lite.output: normalized landmarks (33,4): x, y, z, visibility
mediapipe/pose_landmarker_lite.notes: BlazePose GHUM lite. Lightman uses shoulders, elbows, wrists and hand points only.
